label: fraud
message: CBI cyber cell se bol rahe hain. Aapka naam money laundering case mein hai; digital arrest se bachne ke liye abhi video call join karo aur OTP share karo.
why: Impersonation, legal threat, urgency, and OTP request occur together.

label: fraud
message: साइबर क्राइम अधिकारी बोल रहा हूं। आपका खाता केस में फंसा है, गिरफ्तारी रोकने के लिए तुरंत स्क्रीन शेयर करके ओटीपी बताइए।
why: Authority impersonation plus arrest threat and OTP collection.

label: fraud
message: Refund receive karne ke liye UPI collect request accept karo. PIN enter karte hi ₹5,000 refund aa jayega, abhi approve karo.
why: A collect request and PIN are incorrectly presented as a way to receive money.

label: fraud
message: Sir, refund kittan UPI collect request accept cheyyu. PIN enter cheythal amount credit aakum, ippol thanne approve cheyyane.
why: Malayalam-English code switching with refund/collect/PIN deception.

label: fraud
message: Ungal bank KYC expire aagiduchu. Account block aagurathukku munnaadi link open panni card number, CVV and OTP update pannunga.
why: KYC expiry threat requesting card data and OTP.

label: fraud
message: Bank verification ke liye AnyDesk install karo aur 6 digit session code share karo. Aapke account se suspicious transaction ho raha hai, jaldi karo.
why: Remote-access installation request combined with urgency and bank impersonation.

label: fraud
message: आपका सिम 2 घंटे में बंद हो जाएगा। केवाईसी अपडेट करने के लिए नीचे दिए लिंक पर आधार और बैंक ओटीपी डालें।
why: Service cutoff threat plus credential/OTP collection on a lookalike-style URL.

label: fraud
message: RBI approved instant loan release ho gaya hai. Processing fee ₹99 is UPI ID par bhejo, warna loan cancel aur CIBIL down ho jayega.
why: False regulator reference, advance fee, and CIBIL threat.

label: fraud
message: Customs parcel-il illegal item undu. Case close cheyyan fine ippol UPI-il pay cheyyu, allenkil police veettil varum.
why: Customs/police impersonation, arrest threat, and urgent UPI payment.

label: fraud
message: Your payroll account will be suspended today. Sign in immediately and enter your password, card CVV, and OTP to retain access.
why: The local GuardAIN phishing fixture combines credential collection, urgency, and a suspicious page pattern.

label: fraud
message: Prize claim karne ke liye QR scan karke ₹1 verification payment karo. Payment ke baad cashback automatically aa jayega, screenshot bhejna mat bhoolna.
why: The local UPI fraud fixture corroborates payment urgency with a deceptive QR/payment narrative.

label: fraud
message: Guaranteed 30% weekly return sirf aaj ke liye. Trading account activate karne ke liye seed money is UPI ID pe bhejo aur PAN plus OTP WhatsApp karo.
why: Guaranteed returns, pressure, upfront payment, and identity/OTP collection.
